sn4.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati himavantappadese araññakuṭikāyaṃ.
sn4.20:1.2: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn4.20:1.3: sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātanaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.1: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn4.20:2.2: kāretu bhante bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu sugato rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātanaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.3: kiṃ pana me tvaṃ pāpima passasi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi
sn4.20:2.4: kāretu bhante bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu sugato rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.5: bhagavato kho bhante cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
sn4.20:2.6: ākaṅkhamāno pana bhante bhagavā himavantaṃ pabbatarājaṃ suvaṇṇantveva adhimucceyya suvaṇṇapabbatassāti. pabbattassa
sn4.20:5.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
